data.body: Investigation complete (INTERMEDIATE tier): ROOT_CAUSE confirmed. The outbound bridge's commit-cap safety (default=500 commits) fires on every CI run — the tickets branch accumulates 400-1000+ commits/day. When cap triggers, _seed_at_head() advances the cursor to HEAD without processing any events. Confirmed: 462/462 tickets have no jira_key (0% synced). Bridge alerts show cap-exceeded on every run since cold-start. This is a bridge-wide issue affecting ALL ticket types including epics. Fix: change cap-exceeded to fail loudly (raise exception) instead of silently skipping.
